newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh names new securities & exchange chief.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh names new securities & exchange chief.

text.p: Bangladesh has appointed Mohammad Abu Sayeed, a retired civil bureaucrat, as the new chief of the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), the official BSS news agency said on Sunday quoting a government announcement.
Sayeed's appointment followed the resignation of Harunur Rashid as the head of the capital market watchdog late last month.
Rashid, also a retired bureaucrat, resigned on June 29 complaining of a lack of cooperation and support from the government in his efforts to reform the troubled capital market.
The stock market reacted adversely to the resignation of Rashid, who initiated some tough legal action against some issuers and brokers found involved in price manipulation after a recent inquiry.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange all share price index dropped 1.49 percent to 1,032.36 on Sunday, a working day in Bangladesh.
The government also appointed Mohammad Sekender Ali, a career banker, as an advisor to the SEC.
